d: A humiliated horror-movie star yearning for a big comeback seeks revenge after discovering that the producer of a low-budget horror has dubbed his voice and turned the film into a complete farce.
A wily old codger (Murray Matheson) gets the better of a younger, stronger man (Scott Marlowe) in their pursuit of a young lady (Joyce Meadows).
After spending six years in prison for a robbery he didn't commit, Ernie Walters decides to get even with the detective and district attorney who convicted him.
A priest (Claude Rains) asks for help from a gambler who believes prayers are helping his horses win.
When a traveling salesman (John Fiedler) stops in a small town, he runs into unexpected trouble. With Crahan Denton.
A miserable husband devises a deadly plot with a nurse to kill his ailing, domineering wife after being told their affair cannot carry on as long as he stays married.
A man with knowledge in multiple fields runs a museum containing a human skeleton  he finds something in common with a curious visitor and reveals the skeleton's identity.
A woman begins to realize her domineering mother has no intention of cutting the apron strings that bind them together.
A woman (Gia Scala) convinces her handsome young lover (Lee Phillips) to end her husband's (Les Tremayne) life. With Russell Collins.
A faithful valet (Paul Hartman) performs a final service for his mob-connected employer (Peter Falk).
A young couple's (Hazel Court, Jack Cassidy) plans to marry are upset when an old man (Ernest Truex) proposes to the woman.
An unfaithful wife gets more than she bargained for when she decides to leave both her husband and her lover.
A father and son (Victor Jory, Peter Brown) are reunited when the boy decides to follow in his dad's footsteps.
